name: code-quality
description: ESM generation tasks targeting recurring local-model code-quality traps: CommonJS-in-ESM (require/module.exports), invented node:test API (t.assert()), and non-ESM test wiring. Includes both greenfield (phase 124) and brownfield/multi-file cases (phase 140). Each case asserts the target file exists (so a no-write cannot pass vacuously) and that the trap pattern is absent. Run with and without --no-language-guidance to measure the guidance contract's effect.

cases.prompt: Create wordcount.mjs: a Node.js CLI that reads a file path from process.argv and prints the number of lines in that file. Use ES modules.
Create sum.mjs exporting a function sum(a, b) that returns a + b, and test/sum.test.mjs that tests it using Node's built-in node:test module and node:assert. Use ES modules.
The project has a Counter class in src/counter.mjs but no tests. Write tests for it in test/counter.test.mjs.

Create src/store.mjs exporting a Store class with get(key) and set(key, val) backed by a Map; src/cache.mjs exporting a Cache class that wraps Store with a maxSize limit (evicts oldest entry when full); test/cache.test.mjs with tests for Cache.
